title: The Expansion Center and Dynamical Age of the Galactic Supernova Remnant Cassiopeia A

evidence.locator: Abstract: expansion center alpha = 23h 23m 27.77s ± 0.05s, delta = 58° 48' 49.4" ± 0.4" (ICRS), from the proper motions of 21 main-shell and 17 outer knots; it lies 6.6 ± 1.5 arcsec almost due north of the central X-ray point source; a distance of 3.4 kpc; knot convergent date A.D. 1671.3 ± 0.9, assuming no deceleration.
